# OMP NInfer

> Durable local inference for coding agents: the qualified local inference appliance for
> Oh My Pi. Your coding session should survive the process. Oh My Pi (coding-agent client) →
> OMP NInfer (qualified appliance and release layer) → NInfer (inference engine) → Qwen3.8 27B
> (served model). Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Oh My Pi, Qwen, or
> NVIDIA.

Qualified on RTX 5090 · 4090 · 3090 — **v0.14.0** (published 2026-10-28, GitHub Latest), stock
**Oh My Pi 18.12.6** (`45c35e40`). The 0.x series supports only the latest published release and its
exact manifest and profiles.
- **RTX 5090 container lane:** Windows 11 + Docker Desktop/WSL2 on loopback `127.0.0.1:18089`
  (local Windows client, manual macOS SSH tunnel preview, or Linux x64 client under WSL2); `v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.3` (source
  `2c6f423b` on `Neroued/ninfer` master `64d10fbf`, image `760fb6be`, server `55f0b95a`), profile
  `qwen38-5090-v0.13.0` (config `751d22dc`), model container v3 `81f924d4` (20.4 GB, served model ID `q38-ninfer`), DFlash2 draft window
  7, BF16 KV (146,368 automatic tokens), 131,072-token context, two requests in flight, schema 3
  checkpoints (`checkpoints-v013`, strict origin auth, non-blocking export), JSON-schema output,
  128-character tool names, vision + tools.
- **RTX 4090 and RTX 3090 native Windows 11 lanes:** `v0.7.0-qwen38-4090-beta.3` (package
  `87038cfb`, server `5caa7780`, profile `qwen38-4090-native-v0.7.0-beta.3`, config `b5cfbf50`,
  14,787.734375 MiB shared Host budget, 640 MiB admission headroom) and
  `v0.7.0-qwen38-3090-beta.3` (package `a7637f66`, server `fedce425`, profile
  `qwen38-3090-native-v0.7.0-beta.3`, config `d08d262b`, 11,715.734375 MiB shared Host budget, 768
  MiB admission headroom, 350 W serving cap; stop a running v0.13.1 RTX 3090 lane with `Control-Release.ps1 -Action Stop` before upgrading,
  [#94](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/issues/94)) on loopback `127.0.0.1:18082`, built from the same `2c6f423b` source on `Neroued/ninfer`
  master `64d10fbf`, UUID-bound on one two-GPU host (sequential single-GPU serving, one lane at a
  time; no supported rollback target as the first release of each beta.3 lineage), shared model
  container v3 `81f924d4` (20.4 GB, `qwen3_8_27b-v3.ninfer`; served model IDs `qwen3.8-27b` on RTX 4090 and `q38-ninfer` on RTX 3090), MTP3 (`--lm-head-draft`), INT8 KV,
  `Group64` A8 off, 131,072-token context, one request at a time, schema 3 checkpoints
  (`session-checkpoints-v3`, strict origin auth), JSON-schema output, 128-character tool names,
  SPDX + CycloneDX dependency SBOMs, text + tools (no vision).
- **Proof:** Fresh acceptance on frozen candidate `c81a8e7e` across five documented routes
  (31 steps), all three stock client binaries (macOS arm64 preview, Windows x64, Linux x64
  under WSL2), and both native Windows public installs (owner-operated, 421.229 s corrected RTX 5090
  hold, 392.504 s RTX 4090 window, 393.945 s RTX 3090 window); all three lane runtime qualifications
  are fresh at `2c6f423b` (RTX 5090 182.49 tok/s server decode and 57.00 s cold exact 130,048-token
  retrieval; RTX 4090 151.54 tok/s C1 decode and 81.78 s exact retrieval; RTX 3090 90.64 tok/s C1
  decode and 187.88 s exact retrieval).

## Release authorities

- [Release manifest](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.14.0/releases/v0.14.0/manifest.json): exact client, runtime, model, and profile pins
- [Release notes](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.14.0/releases/v0.14.0/NINFER_RELEASE_NOTES.md): release composition, qualification tables, reproducibility exception, and support boundaries
- [Tagged quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.14.0/docs/QUICKSTART.md): immutable installation guide for the current release

- [Canonical facts](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/FACTS.md): entity relationship, fit, lane table, models, durability, and checkpoint transport

- [Architecture](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): state ownership, loopback topology, checkpoint replication, and identity chain
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): methodology, per-lane qualification numbers, and historical receipts
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): trust boundary, loopback invariants, key handling, and verification
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): failure signatures, recovery, and safe reporting
- [Media provenance](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/media/README.md): recording provenance, hashes, and historical demo scope
